<b>Gahlias</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are floral foes with mask-like cores that they thrust forward to bludgeon unwary bugs.<ref>Gahlia [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Floral foe with a core shaped to mimic a mask. The core can be thrust forth to bludgeon unwary bugs."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] enters their attack range, Gahlias open their petals and shortly afterwards launch their mask-like core forward on a long stalk. This extends their hitbox, allowing them to strike Hornet while simultaneously making them an easier target.

On death, a Gahlia's mask drops and can be hit or [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bounced]] off. After being struck, the mask shatters into {{S|5}} on its next impact with a surface.

Gahlias deal {{Damage|1}} on contact with their petals and core. However, they do not deal contact damage from behind. This is demonstrated by a specific Gahlia in the eastern [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] room in [[Shellwood]]: it blocks a passageway, allowing Hornet to attack it safely from behind, though she cannot pass until it is defeated.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Gahlias have their health doubled. They gain one of the following [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void attacks]]: Void Blades, Void Tendrils, or Void Projectiles.
